races.display_title: 4 x 4 Tyres Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Hopefully the ground doesn't dry out too much for TRINITY STREET , who looks the one to beat with sights lowered on return. TRINITY STREET (IRE) ROSIE MAHLER (IRE) CAPRICCIOSE (IRE)

races.display_title: Happy Birthday Penny Tyacke Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A warm-looking race in which the market will likely prove useful but GATINEAU PARK did well over hurdles last season and this former point winner firmly appeals as the type to make an even better chaser. He could be worth siding with for a yard amongst the winners. Jipcot has more races in him from his present mark and is feared along with George's Lad . Aintree scorer Mr Hope Street is another to note for all this trip may be on the short side on seasonal bow. GATINEAU PARK (IRE) JIPCOT (FR) GEORGE'S LAD (IRE)

races.display_title: J.H. Rowe Memorial Handicap Chase
races.verdict: ITHAKA followed his breakthrough win over fences with a trio of non-completions, but it's reasonable to assume he can bounce back now setting out for a new yard which is in rude health. Moor End was all out to hold on at Chepstow when last seen in March but goes well fresh and should remain competitive from only 2 lb higher in the weights. Fellow last-time-out winner Pescatorius is also feared, for all that this is a tougher assignment. ITHAKA (IRE) MOOR END (IRE) PESCATORIUS (IRE)

races.display_title: Bristol Motor Club Handicap
races.verdict: UNICO was the subject of strong support and looked unfortunate not to reward her backers when finishing third behind reopposing Roman Spring at Brighton 2 weeks ago, finishing well having conceded first run. She's fancied to confirm the promise of that effort from an unchanged mark. Whiteley Way , Up The Anti and aforementioned Roman Spring are a trio of others to consider. UNICO WHITELEY WAY UP THE ANTI (IRE)

races.display_title: MJ Church Handicap
races.verdict: Course winner LEGENDSOFTHELAND has been much improved this season, winning for the third time at Ffos Las in July. He's remained in good form of late, unlucky not to finish closer when fourth at Nottingham on his latest outing 2 weeks ago. He shades preference over Iconic Dawn who looks worthy of a crack at the minimum trip. In-form 5-y-o Call Time and last year's winner Lahina Bay are others to consider. LEGENDSOFTHELAND (IRE) ICONIC DAWN CALL TIME (IRE)

races.display_title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict: DISTILLATE is going through a good spell at present, making it back-to-back C&D wins with a clear-cut success 10 days ago, and she looks to hold leading claims without a penalty for that latest victory. The biggest threat could come from Keep Me Stable who has dropped to a career-low mark, ahead of Edmond Halley . DISTILLATE KEEP ME STABLE (IRE) EDMOND HALLEY (IRE)

races.verdict: Course winner YORKSHIRE was caught wider than ideal last time and looks well worth another chance off a 3 lb lower mark. First Legion could have a big say if translating his recent turf form to all-weather, while it'll be no surprise to see Storm Free bounce back on return to this track (1-1). YORKSHIRE (IRE) FIRST LEGION (IRE) STORM FREE

races.display_title: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
races.verdict: SEVENKINGSMUSTDIE continued a theme of gradual progression when opening his account in game fashion at Wolverhampton 4 weeks ago and a token 2 lb rise can see Alan King's low-mileage 4-y-o highly competitive again now his stamina is tested further. Sycamore Gap revived when making a successful stable debut over C&D last week and is feared, as is another last-time-out C&D scorer Fleur de Mer . SEVENKINGSMUSTDIE (IRE) SYCAMORE GAP FLEUR DE MER (IRE)

races.display_title: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
races.verdict: COBALT COMET hasn't been the most consistent to date but he did well to split a pair ridden closer to the pace when second at Wolverhampton 31 days ago and could just be worth chancing to build on that from a 1 lb higher mark. Sea The Light bounced back to form in no uncertain terms when forging clear at Wolverhampton 10 days ago and he's a big player under a penalty. Meet Me In Meraki back on a left-handed track and Harlington are others to consider. COBALT COMET SEA THE LIGHT (IRE) MEET ME IN MERAKI

races.display_title: See You At The GR1 Double Header 21 & 22 November Handicap (0-60) (Div 2)
races.verdict: REAL PETITE turned a big-field handicap into a one-sided affair at Gowran 10 days ago and on that evidence, her revised mark may well be within reach. Pocket Jacks was also impressive when scoring at Dundalk on Wednesday and is a huge danger if allowed to take her chance. Buttermere Ridge is also of some interest. REAL PETITE (GER) POCKET JACKS (IRE) BUTTERMERE RIDGE (IRE)
